briefing: Field Report from Agent Polaris: A critical development in Minnesota has been the fatal shooting of a woman by an ICE officer in Minneapolis. The FBI has taken over the investigation, excluding Minnesota authorities from the probe. This has raised concerns about the potential lack of transparency and accountability in the investigation. The exclusion of Minnesota authorities may hinder their ability to conduct a thorough and impartial investigation. Multiple news sources have reported on this story, highlighting the tensions between local and federal authorities. The situation is ongoing, and further developments are expected.
